real_mcp_protocol.details: ClientSession negotiated protocolVersion 2025-11-25 and ToolsCapability over MemoryObject streams
Client received ListToolsResult containing only ALLOWed tools; quarantined and blocked tools stripped at protocol level
Calls to unapproved tools return CallToolResult(isError=True) with diagnostic denial text
Upstream exceptions (ZeroDivisionError) forwarded as CallToolResult(isError=True) with exact upstream error text
Unregistered tool invocations rejected with UNREGISTERED status without upstream query
Client and server task groups cancel and close stream channels without hang or leaked loops

descriptor_integrity_and_lifecycle.details: Character modifications change SHA-256 hash and trigger QUARANTINE
Renaming a tool causes it to be treated as NEW_TOOL (quarantined) while old name disappears
Modifying inputSchema with identical description triggers SCHEMA_MODIFIED and revokes automatic trust
Removed tools disappear; reappearing tools matching approved baseline hash are re-allowed immediately
Approving a tool on ServerA does not approve it on ServerB (keyed by server_name, tool_name)
Rolling back upstream text to exact approved baseline hash restores ALLOW; rolling back to unapproved draft stays QUARANTINED
save_to_disk and load_from_disk persist approved descriptors, hashes, and version history across restarts
Approval of descriptor A never approves descriptor B, even with identical description or similar names

security_enforcement.details: Upstream execution counter strictly 0 for unregistered tools
Upstream execution counter strictly 0 for quarantined tools
Upstream execution counter strictly 0 for prompt-injection and credential-access tools
Attempting direct tools/call without prior tools/list inspection is denied with UNREGISTERED status
Missing model directory raises FileNotFoundError; interceptor without model refuses unverified changes
Model prediction exceptions and uninitialized models assign CRITICAL risk and raise PredictionError
Mandatory security rules trigger BLOCK regardless of ML score, threshold, or MDP policy mode
revoke_approval and revoke_tool_approval immediately revoke active decision and place tool in QUARANTINE

ml_and_policy_separation.property: ML Score Is Probabilistic Risk, Not Proof of Malice
ml_and_policy_separation.details: Unapproved changes with medium/high risk are QUARANTINED (reviewable), not irreversibly purged
Benign documentation rephrasing has hash mismatch but triggers QUARANTINE, not BLOCK
Mandatory security violations trigger RULE_MANDATORY_SECURITY_VIOLATION even when mode is 'mdp'
Promotions record UTC timestamps, version increments, and audit log entries

security_edge_cases.details: Empty and whitespace strings evaluated as CRITICAL risk with probability 1.0 (fail-closed)
Evaluated in 4-6 ms without memory spike, buffer overflow, or timeout
Normalized and hashed deterministically without encoding exceptions
Upstream returning [clean_tool, poisoned_duplicate] causes clean_tool to be stripped from allowed tools
Non-dict, non-Tool, and None objects in upstream tools/list are safely skipped without crashing

untested_behaviors: OS-level kernel stdio pipe redirection for arbitrary non-Python compiled binaries
Streaming chunked tool execution results over SSE / HTTP streaming transports
Dynamic runtime tool argument injection inspection (complementary input validation)
Asymmetric cryptographic signature verification of descriptor baseline hashes (PKI/HSM)

known_limitations.impact: Requires upstream MCP servers or clients to route through the gateway MCP endpoint
JSON file persistence is local; multi-node clusters require distributed key-value storage

known_limitations.limitation: Statistical False Positives on High Imperative Descriptions
known_limitations.impact: Benign developer tools with words like 'execute', 'overwrite', 'query' may score between 0.30 and 0.50, requiring initial manual approval
